result.instructions: Technical checks only. Results describe checked coverage and limitations.

tools.name: check_headshot_photo
tools.title: Check headshot photo
tools.description: Use this when the user wants technical checks of one professional profile or job-application photo from a public HTTPS URL or base64. Maximum 8 MB; JPEG/PNG pixel analysis requires full mode and at most 4 megapixels; otherwise only headers are checked. WebP receives header checks only. Face framing is not checked. URL fetching is limited to 8 seconds and 3 redirects. Do not use for image creation, editing, personal-attribute judgments or identity verification. The image is analysed in memory and not stored. It does not generate or edit images. It does not judge attractiveness, identity, age, gender, ethnicity or any other personal attribute; no biometric identification.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS image URL without credentials or custom port. IP literals and internal hosts are blocked.

image_base64.description: One JPEG, PNG or WebP encoded as base64, optionally prefixed by data:image/...;base64,. At most 8,000,000 decoded bytes.

tools.name: get_headshot_photo_requirements
tools.title: Get headshot requirements
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a technical headshot checklist and crop recommendations for LinkedIn, XING or job applications. Returns static recommendations, not official platform upload limits; no image input or network access. Do not use for assessing an actual image or confirming platform acceptance. The image is analysed in memory and not stored. It does not generate or edit images. It does not judge attractiveness, identity, age, gender, ethnicity or any other personal attribute; no biometric identification.

recommendations.digital: 600 × 800 px; evaluator warns at short edge >=600 and long edge >=750
recommendations.print: 1200 × 1600 px recommended; evaluator passes at short edge >=1200 and long edge >=1500
recommendations.formats: JPEG or PNG for full analysis; WebP dimensions only
recommendations.brightness: 35–76% mean luminance; dark clipping <=16%, bright clipping <=20%
recommendations.sharpness: Experimental recommendation: Laplacian variance >=100 pass; >=30 warn on <=256 px grid

checklist: Use the original camera file; avoid enlarging a small image.
Use soft, frontal daylight and avoid clipped highlights or shadows.
Clean the camera lens and avoid backlighting.
Check white balance against a neutral wall or shirt collar.
Choose a plain or softly blurred background.
Manually check head and shoulders, eyes near the upper third and room around the head.
